description: FateCat local developer portal release baseline. This contract makes the developer entrypoints, SDK release baseline, sandbox fixtures, fixed snapshots and validation commands discoverable without claiming a public hosted portal.
privacyBoundary: Developer portal contracts and docs must not store real tokens, secrets, production URLs, non-Beijing real places, real users, report bodies or benchmark answer details.
requiredLocalEvidence: SDK examples pass local syntax/package smoke
sandbox fixtures execute through FastAPI TestClient
sandbox access gateway enforces token scope, rate limit and audit redaction locally
fixed sandbox output snapshots match redacted canonical digests
API changelog contains the 0086 release-baseline entry
external public portal and public sandbox token service remain explicitly not implemented
limitations: Does not prove an external hosted developer portal is live.
Does not provide a public sandbox token service.
Does not store production credentials, production URLs, real user data or report bodies.
